specs.name: 푸딩똥
specs.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / game character costume edit.
Create ONE FINISHED, FLATTENED FULL CHARACTER SPRITE on a genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG background, not a sheet or a collage. Input image 1 is the existing character and MUST preserve its identity, recognizable body proportions, facial expression, eye spacing, colors, perspective and painterly hand-painted style. Input image 2 is ONLY the costume design reference: small gold crown, ruby gem, rich burgundy cloth and gold edging. Do NOT reproduce its separated pieces.
Paint a custom-fitted royal cape ON the character, integrated with its anatomy, shared lighting, soft contact shadows, convincing attachment points and draped folds. The key goal is a cape visibly WORN: two generous flowing burgundy fabric panels must descend from the upper sides of the body down both sides, occupying roughly 25-35% of the finished silhouette, with some fabric wrapping in front at the side edges. Keep the entire face exposed. A small ruby fastening below the mouth connects the front panels. The fabric must visibly hang down vertically and curve around the body, not be a flat red carpet, plate, base pedestal or tiny hem underneath. Gold piping follows cloth folds.
The crown's bottom physically rests on the head in the correct perspective with a subtle contact shadow, never floating. Keep all distinctive anatomical features of the source. No humanoid neck, legs or torso, no additional arms, no extra characters. Keep a clear friendly cute game aesthetic.
Frame the entire finished sprite including crown, cape and any existing effects with comfortable transparent margins on all sides, centered, on a square canvas. Soft clean alpha edge; no white sticker border, no ground plane or background, no text, no UI. Preserve normal warm original character color and original facial expression so we compare ONLY the costume, not new materials or expressions.
Character-specific fitting: preserve the low wide caramel pudding, flat elliptical caramel top with the SAME caramel drips, pale golden custard, glossy round brown eyes, tiny smile and rosy cheeks. No poop swirl on top. Crown small and centered directly on the flat caramel top. Cape starts just below the caramel rim at the upper side corners and drapes substantially down BOTH sides; side panels partly wrap around the lower sides, leaving the central custard and face unobstructed. It must read as pudding wearing a tailored royal mantle, not pudding sitting on red cloth.

refinement.prompt: Precise object edit. Input1 is the ORIGINAL short wide pudding character. Input2 is the first finished royal costume sprite. Edit Input2: ONLY correct the pudding BODY proportions to match Input1 more faithfully. The custard must be noticeably SHORTER and WIDER, a low squat truncated cone. Target the unclothed body width:height ratio of original, about 1.4:1, INCLUDING the caramel top, not counting the crown. In the current royal version there is too much tall blank custard below the face/clasp: shorten this lower section substantially, bringing the base closer beneath the smile. Keep the face positions and scale consistent with the original low pudding, and keep original caramel ellipse and drips. Tailor the two burgundy cape panels to this shorter wider body, retain substantial visible cloth on both sides and gold trim, but no long empty belly or human-like torso. Maintain the beautifully integrated crown resting on caramel, ruby clasp, soft fabric folds, hand-painted style and warm light of Input2. This is one finished sprite, not component layers. Fully visible character and clothing, centered with generous margins, truly transparent background. No words or scenery. Preserve transparency.

notes: Three standalone complete sprite candidates; original assets untouched. Pudding v2 selected after shortening body.
